roleContext.jobDescription: The company sells a help-desk platform to mid-sized businesses, and its in-product search lets agents find knowledge-base articles and past tickets. The Machine Learning Engineer improves search relevance: training learning-to-rank models, running offline evaluation against judged query sets, shipping models behind online A/B tests and supporting two graduate engineers who joined the team this year. The panel will consult the evidence packet when it draws up the interview shortlist. The search team has five engineers and a product manager and reports to the head of machine learning. Ranking models run in a Python service behind the search API, and each model change needs an offline evaluation, an A/B test plan and approval at the architecture review before release.

requirements.text: Trains and tunes learning-to-rank models for product search.
Builds offline evaluation using judged query sets and ranking metrics such as NDCG.
Ships ranking models behind online A/B tests together with the platform team.
Mentors graduate engineers through code review and pairing.
Writes design documents for relevance changes and presents them at the architecture review.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Machine Learning Engineer, Search Relevance

## Experience

- Personal details: date of birth 3 February 1999; Indian national, in the UK on a graduate-route visa valid until August 2027; unmarried.
- Trained LambdaMART and cross-encoder re-ranking models for the article search of Quillstack, a documentation SaaS product, tuning features such as click-through, freshness and title match.
- Built the offline evaluation harness: 2,400 queries with graded relevance judgements from the support team, reporting NDCG@10 and MRR for every candidate model before release.
- Shipped three ranking models through online A/B tests on the platform team's experimentation service, writing the analysis plan for each test before launch.
- Reviewed pull requests from a summer intern on the search team and paired with the intern on the evaluation harness for six weeks.

## Work samples

- Work sample: a design document for adding a freshness feature to article ranking, with the offline NDCG@10 comparison table, the A/B test plan, the rollback criteria and the architecture review's comments.
